question: Compare our suppliers — who is the most reliable?
agent_answer:
Here's the full supplier reliability comparison (source: SRM):

| Rank | Supplier | ID | Rating | On-Time Rate | Avg Lead Days | Declared Lead | Orders |
|------|----------|----|--------|-------------|---------------|---------------|--------|
| 1 | **Somchai Mango Farm** | SUP-001 | 4.5 | **100%** (13/13) | 2.9 days | 3 days | 14 |
| 2 | **Rayong Tropical** | SUP-004 | 4.0 | **100%** (6/6) | 2.8 days | 3 days | 7 |
| 3 | Isaan Organic Farms | SUP-005 | 3.5 | 33% (3/9) | 7.1 days | 6 days | 10 |
| 4 | Prachuap Harvest | SUP-003 | 2.8 | 25% (2/8) | 5.1 days | 4 days | 10 |
| 5 | Northern Fruits Co. | SUP-002 | 3.2 | 24% (4/17) | 6.3 days | 5 days | 19 |

**Clear winner: Somchai Mango Farm (SUP-001)** — 100% on-time rate across 14 orders (the largest sample), actual delivery averaging 2.9 days vs. their declared 3-day lead time, and the highest rating (4.5). Rayong Tropical (SUP-004) also has a perfect on-time rate but with only 7 orders, a smaller track record.

**Red flag:** Northern Fruits Co. (SUP-002) and Prachuap Harvest (SUP-003) both clock in at ~24–25% on-time — meaning roughly 3 in 4 deliveries arrive late. Isaan Organic Farms also consistently exceeds its declared lead time (7.1 days actual vs. 6 declared). These three should be deprioritized for time-sensitive restocking.
